# scripts/Test-KbLeaks.ps1

<!-- Generated by scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1 from the code. Do not edit; edit the code and regenerate. -->

Runs the brain's sensitive-text guard over the family knowledge base (docs/knowledge/) and llms.txt.

The family checks (scripts/kb/validate.py) catch email addresses and public IPv4 addresses. This adds the rest of the brain's guard (docs/knowledge-spec.md §8): GUIDs other than placeholders, UNC paths, default Windows machine names, and, in an organization fork, phrases on the hashed customer denylist (knowledge/denylist.sha256). One line per finding, then RESULT PASS or RESULT FAIL (exit 1). CI runs it in kb-validate.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `-Path` | string | no | `(Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent)` | The repo root to scan. |

## Examples

```powershell
./scripts/Test-KbLeaks.ps1
```
